---
title: "Part-day"
subtitle: "Two halves, with a facilitator"
---

This format takes the Europeanisation and the economy case study in a slot of three hours, with nothing to install, no account to open and nothing preregistered. You work as analyst number six on a claim of the original author (OA) that five analysts reanalysed for the SCORE robustness study (Aczel et al. 2026).

## How you work

The session runs on its deck, whose slides carry the cells of the tasks: R loads inside the deck in your browser, with the data already in place. The browser lab, a page of this site that holds the tasks outside the deck, is the fallback.

[Open the deck](../../live/short.html){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"} [Open the browser lab](../../lab.qmd){.btn .btn-outline-primary target="_blank"}
